attempts.summary: Established a site-to-site IPsec tunnel between node1 (VyOS, LAN-A router) and node2 (OPNsense, LAN-B router) across a dedicated transit network (10.10.99.0/30), carrying private networks lan-a (10.10.10.0/24, node3) and lan-b (10.10.20.0/24, node4) encrypted end-to-end. Verified via live ESP packet capture on the transit link and SA byte counters incrementing on both peers. Discovered and worked around an OPNsense/FreeBSD pf limitation: decrypted policy-based IPsec traffic cannot be matched by legacy filter rules (enc0/ipsec pseudo-interfaces, and even a VTI interface, are excluded from the filter compiler's assignable-interface mapping), resolved using OPNsense's officially supported "disablefilter" toggle. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol on all 4 nodes sequentially, confirming a changed boot identity and full recovery (addressing, routes, IPsec SA, cross-node encrypted ping) after each restart.
